#include <assert.h>

int main(void) {
    TS_PACKAlefHandle config_handle = ts_pack_process_config_from_json("{\"language\":\"m68k\"}");
    TS_PACKAlefHandle result = ts_pack_process(" move.l d0,d1\n", config_handle);
